text: Sucking-insect pests: Thrips — tiny (1-1.5mm) yellow/brown insects that scar leaves and rasp fruit, also a virus vector; control chemicals: Neem oil, Fenpyroximate, Thiamethoxam, Acetameprid, Imidacloprid, Emamectin Benzoate, Spinetoram, Lambda-Cyhalothrin. Aphids — cluster on young leaves/shoots/flowers, reproduce without mating, also a virus vector; control: Imidacloprid, Dinotefuran, Pymetrozine, Acephate, Buprofezin, Acetameprid. Whitefly — small white flies (1-1.5mm) feeding on leaf sap, also a virus vector; control: Fenpyroximate, Buprofezin, Pymetrozine, Thiamethoxam, Acetameprid. Spider mite — tiny red mites (~0.5mm) causing bronzed/dry-looking leaves; control: Abamectin, Fenpyroximate, Chlorfenapyr, Buprofezin. General prevention for all: remove and destroy field debris/hosts after harvest.
